reason: Four real GA4 tools registered by shared MCP factory, reachable from source tsx stdio CLI and Worker HTTP transport; defective compiled npm start does not invalidate these alternative entrypoints.

tools.name: ga4_listAccounts
tools.description: Return the GA4 accounts visible to the configured service account
tools.behavior: Returns cached or fetched account summaries and nested property summaries as JSON text and structured accounts. Node uses paginated Admin API async iterator; Worker calls REST accountSummaries once.
notes: No inputSchema supplied in registration; empty object represents SDK no-argument tool.
Worker ignores nextPageToken; results can omit later pages.

tools.name: ga4_listProperties
tools.description: List properties that belong to a given GA4 account

accountId.description: GA4 account identifier, with or without the accounts/ prefix

tools.behavior: Fetches/caches properties using Admin API parent account filter and returns normalized property summaries as JSON text and structured properties. Node normalizes optional accounts/ prefix.
notes: Worker unconditionally prepends accounts/ in REST filter and parent output, so accountId accounts/123 yields parent:accounts/accounts/123 despite advertised prefix support.
Worker ignores nextPageToken; Node paginates with listPropertiesAsync.

tools.name: ga4_getMetadata
tools.description: Retrieve dimensions and metrics metadata for a GA4 property. If propertyId is omitted, falls back to config DEFAULT_GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

propertyId.description: GA4 property identifier, with or without the properties/ prefix

tools.behavior: Resolves propertyId or configured default, fails if neither exists, normalizes properties/ prefix and retrieves/caches property dimensions and metrics metadata; returns JSON text and structured metadata.
notes: Omitted propertyId requires DEFAULT_GA4_PROPERTY_ID configured; no schema default exists.

tools.name: ga4_runReport
tools.description: Execute a GA4 report query for the provided property, metrics, and optional dimensions.

propertyId.description: GA4 property identifier, with or without the properties/ prefix

items.description: API name of the metric to include in the report
API name of the dimension to include in the report

endDate.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD or relative, e.g. today)

tools.behavior: Converts metric/dimension names to GA name objects; uses nonempty dateRanges or startDate/endDate with handler fallbacks 7daysAgo/today; forwards property, metrics, dimensions, dateRanges and limit to Data API runReport. Returns report structured content plus row/header summary and up to three sample rows.
notes: Date strings have no format constraint; dateRanges may be empty and triggers handler fallback. Fallback dates are handler behavior, not schema defaults.
Underlying services support filters, offset, orderBys and quota options but MCP input schema does not expose them.
Source review only; no upstream execution, tools/list, or live requests. Git HEAD matches supplied revision.

All four tools register unconditionally; service is constructed lazily on first call. No optional tool modules, permission-tier tool inventories, aliases, or further registerTool/tool calls found. REST endpoints in manifest.ts are not MCP tools.

package.json start/main targets dist/index.js, while tsconfig.json rootDir "." emits src/index.ts to dist/src/index.js. Plain tsc also retains extensionless ESM imports and tsconfig aliases. npm run mcp instead uses tsx src/mcp/cli-entry.ts; Worker transport uses the same shared factory and Workers-specific real REST clients.

Root wrangler.toml targets dist/src/worker.js. cloudflare/wrangler.toml instead says src/worker.ts relative to its own directory (which has no such source) and contains malformed stray inline-table entries; this alternate config is defective. Worker deployment/build not tested.

Schemas reconstructed from explicit Zod registration shapes; standard object schemas reject additional properties in JSON Schema conversion while Zod validation strips unknown keys. No runtime schema claim.

review.method: Root compared all four shared registrations with nested Zod validators, min/max/requiredness, and traced Node/Workers services; confirmed compiled-entrypoint limitation.
